arget leakage by fitting imputers, encoders, category pooling, and hyperparameter selection inside training folds. Never derive features from listing price. Compare fold-paired errors and bootstrap confidence intervals rather than isolated mean scores. Inspect residuals for heteroskedasticity, regional bias, nonlinear age effects, and systematic underpricing of expensive boats.

## Sensitivity and Robustness

Repeat analysis under alternative duplicate rules, complete-case versus missing-indicator treatments, price winsorization versus robust loss, rare-category thresholds, and grouped versus ordinary folds. Perturb age/length spline complexity and shrinkage strength. Report whether model ranking, factor direction, and interval coverage remain stable.

## Falsification

A target-permutation test should reduce performance to baseline. Reordered rows and harmless whitespace/case changes must not alter predictions materially. Training on prices accidentally included among features must be caught by an explicit feature allowlist. Test impossible years, nonpositive prices, boundary lengths, unseen makes, and sparse regions. Large performance collapse under grouped validation would falsify claims of generalization to unseen designs.

## Reviewer Risks

Major risks are listing-versus-sale bias, omitted boat condition and equipment, duplicate advertisements, geographic selection bias, sparse high-cardinality categories, extrapolation beyond observed designs, and metric mismatch caused by price skew. Causal statements about depreciation or geography are unsupported by this cross-sectional snapshot.
